# Proctoring Stress Cases

Generated by `python tools/proctoring_stress_cases.py generate`.

## Cases

- `case01_single_dense_default_rooms`: Single-monitor dense schedule with default room count and mild restrictions.
- `case02_double_mixed_constraints`: Double-monitor case with gender and internal/external pairing constraints.
- `case03_variable_rooms_overlap`: Single-monitor case with per-subject room counts, overlaps, and anti-consecutive preference.
- `case04_capacity_shortfall`: Single-monitor case that should fail fast because total capacity is insufficient.
- `case05_pairing_impossible`: Double-monitor case that is infeasible under gender plus internal/external pairing rules.
- `case06_dirty_teacher_import`: Teacher import robustness case with duplicate names and malformed cells.
- `case07_locked_conflict_continue`: Continue-scheduling case with overlapping locked assignments for the same teacher.
- `case08_feasible_continue_partial_preset`: Feasible continue-scheduling case with partial double-monitor preset assignments.
- `case09_double_gender_only`: Double-monitor case with only gender-mix enabled.
- `case10_double_internal_only`: Double-monitor case with only internal/external mix enabled.
- `case11_room_repeat_fixed`: Single-monitor case with fixed-room preference enabled.
- `case12_room_repeat_different`: Single-monitor case with different-room preference enabled.
- `case13_invalid_preset_warning_success`: Teacher import warnings for invalid preset rooms should not block scheduling.
- `case14_import_schedule_complete`: Import a complete single-monitor schedule workbook.
- `case15_swap_success`: Manual swap succeeds on an imported complete schedule.
- `case16_swap_blocked_by_preset`: Manual swap is rejected when a teacher has a fixed preset room.

## Commands

- Generate cases: `python tools/proctoring_stress_cases.py generate`
- Run cases: `python tools/proctoring_stress_cases.py run`
